pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Matches the PR words: literal %, _ and \ in title search. Small bug fix with one obvious design, so no spec is needed.
No spec file in the change.
The new tests cover %, _, a mid-string % and a backslash. They would fail against the old unescaped LIKE. I did not run them; the suite needs the Cloudflare workers runtime, which CI runs.
The diff touches no docs, and I found none that describe search wildcards.
The escape order is right: one regex pass escapes \, % and _ together, and the query uses ESCAPE '\'. The query is still parameterised.
The query stays parameterised, and the output is still HTML-escaped. Nothing new is exposed.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters and the claims match the diff. The 'five items' figure fits the three existing items plus the two the test inserts.
